questions.description:
Privacy Notice
The personal data provided during this selection process will be collected and used exclusively for the purpose of evaluating and selecting candidates. By proceeding with your registration, you are aware of the collection, use, and storage of your personal data by VTEX. For further details on how your data will be processed, please visit https://vtex.com/us-en/privacy-and-agreements/hiring-notice/. You will find information on (i) how personal data is processed in VTEX selection processes; (ii) what types of data VTEX collects; (iii) your rights as a data subject; and (iv) how long VTEX processes your data. If you have any questions, please contact our DPO at dpo@vtex.com or request the exercise of your rights as a data subject at https://vtex.com/us-en/data-request.
questions.label: On Data Privacy

questions.description:
The information shared with you during this selection process is strictly confidential and is intended for your evaluation only, and it must be kept strictly confidential by you. It is prohibited to disclose, copy, reproduce or use this information for any other purpose without VTEX's prior authorization in writing. By enrolling in this selection process, you acknowledge that the improper use of the information shared with you may result in losses for VTEX, which may be the subject to remedies.

The obligation of confidentiality will remain in force even after the completion of the selection process. By proceeding with your application, you certify that you read, understood, and agree to the confidentiality terms set forth therein.

If you have any questions about your confidentiality responsibilities or need to report any violation or suspected violation, please immediately contact VTEX's designated contact.

We appreciate your cooperation in protecting and preserving VTEX's confidential information.
